propositions: Four dispatch call sites use cast() to access optional capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) but perform no runtime guard, allowing missing capabilities to fail silently inside broad exception handlers.

When a transport lacks an opt-in capability, AttributeError is swallowed and the mutation is not applied, conflating missing-by-design with actual failure and preventing visibility into capability absence.

isinstance() guards with @runtime_checkable Protocols must be added at all four call sites before capability member access, paired with distinct alert-kind logging to the bridge_alerts channel for absent vs. present-but-failed cases.

The capability guard implementation requires moving _call_with_retry (~75 LOC) from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to satisfy the 800-LOC module-size constraint, with careful preservation of existing test mocks and patches.
